messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm doing a Quickstart refresh for SDK9 and the new auth token flow. Need help updating the env var names + the first deployment examples (Docker -> Cloud Run).

oliver: I can take the deploy snippets. Which runtimes should we show? node20 + python3.11?

maya: Yes node20 + py3.11. Also the SDK renamed the env var: OLD: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> NEW: REDWOOD_TOKEN. Need a clear migration note.

sam: I'll update the code examples. Can someone paste the minimal Dockerfile we want to land so I can run doc tests locally?

oliver: Sure — use this minimal one for the quickstart demo:
```
# Dockerfile
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

maya: Perfect. Also add a curl example showing the new header and env var usage: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

lia: Quick ask — can we include a short migration blurb: how to rotate old API keys into tokens and a note about where tokens live in the console? Might avoid support tickets.

maya: Yes — one paragraph under Auth -> Migration: show CLI revoke/create commands and link to console. Keep it short.

sam: I'll open a PR and include the Dockerfile snippet, the curl examples, and a short migration note. Assigning reviewers: @oliver, @maya, @lia.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — includes markdown lint fixes and updated snippets.

deploy-bot: Preview site built: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai (live for 15m)

oliver: :thumbsup: I'll test the Cloud Run deploy and verify the example env var naming tomorrow morning.

lia: Can we also add a tiny troubleshooting section for first-deploy CORS issues? A one-liner under Deploy Troubleshooting would help.

maya: Yup — add `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` note for demo only + link to production CORS best practices.

sam: Updated PR with CORS troubleshooting note and a tiny section about local env var overrides. CI passed except one link-check flake I fixed.

maya: Thanks all — will review tonight. If no blockers, let's merge and ship the preview before docs meeting.

oliver: I'll post back after testing.
